name: job-collector-brand-tile
label: JOB 黑白品牌图标
preamble: A high-contrast black square app tile with a minimal white intake slot above an oversized heavy white JOB label. Flat front-facing geometry, immediate small-size recognition, no arrows, no container outline, no decorative flourish, no texture, no gradient, and no shadow.

construction.grid: 32-unit keyline; full-bleed square tile; optical centering for both 16px toolbar and 128px store use
construction.corner_radius: 1-unit app tile radius and subtle intake-slot radius
construction.detail_budget: one core idea with three parts: black app tile, white intake slot, JOB label
construction.fill_rule: two flat solid fills only; no outlines or tonal decoration
construction.color_rule: near-black carries the full tile; white is reserved for the intake slot and JOB label
construction.shared_parts: use restrained rectangular geometry with minimal rounding
construction.motif: a short white intake slot above an oversized JOB label
construction.weight_hierarchy: the 900-weight JOB label is primary, the intake slot is secondary, and the black tile is the stable ground

fits: Chrome extension toolbar icon, extension package icon, and 128x128 Chrome Web Store icon.
notes: The SVG master semantically distills the approved docs/design/job-collector-icon-source.png reference. All shipped PNG sizes are rendered from the 128px SVG master. The reusable generation prompt is docs/design/job-collector.prompt.md.
